attempts.detail: The product execution, Verified reopen, cleanup, container removals, and volume removal completed before the embedded verifier indexed an absent Docker HostConfig Tmpfs field directly. An absent field means no tmpfs.

The first recovery used three incorrect evidence literals: mountinfo reports '- fuse layerfs', Docker reports CAP_SYS_ADMIN, and create-then-delete legitimately changes root metadata while returning logical inventory to empty. Raw product equations all passed.
The corrected read-only verifier consumed the original raw artifacts. No product, image, mount, write, unmount, reopen, or cleanup command was rerun.
